theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  classical
  intro ϑ
  induction ϑ with
  | zero =>
    intro u
    contradiction
  | succ ϑ_sub_1 ih =>
    cases ϑ_sub_1 with
    | zero =>
      simp only [zero_add, zero_lt_one, forall_const]
      intro u
      let h_combine := multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (u := u)
      intro hprob_gt
      simp_rw [h_combine, prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
        (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e),
        Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hprob_gt
      have h_u_eq : u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
        funext i
        match i with
        | 0 => rfl
        | 1 => rfl
      rw [h_u_eq]
      exact hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hprob_gt
    | succ ϑ_sub_2 =>
      intro _ u hP
      let ϑ' : ℕ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1
      let U₀ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ') u).1
      let U₁ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ') u).2
      let V₀ := ⋈|U₀
      let V₁ := ⋈|U₁
      let good : F → Prop := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation V₀ V₁ r, MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ ϑ'))) ≤ e
      let R_star_set := R_star_tensor MC (m := ϑ') (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁
      have hP' : Pr_{ let r_last ← $ᵖ F; let r_init ← $ᵖ (Fin ϑ' → F) }[
          Δ₀(multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init, MC) ≤ e]
        = Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ (Fin (ϑ' + 1) → F) }[Δ₀(multilinearCombine u r, MC) ≤ e] := by
        rw [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun (ϑ := ϑ') (F := F)
          (P := fun r_last r_init =>
            Δ₀(multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init, MC) ≤ e)]
        simp only [multilinearCombine_recursive_form (u := u)]
        rfl
      rw [← hP'] at hP
      have h_close : ∀ r : R_star_set,
          jointProximityNat (u := affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r.val) (e := e) (C := MC) :=
        correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor (ih := ih (by omega)) (u := u)
      have h_mem : ∀ r ∈ R_star_set, good r := fun r hr => h_close ⟨r, hr⟩
      have h_line_prob : Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[ good r ]
          > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le
          (prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) (ϑ := ϑ') (u := u) (e := e) hP)
          (Pr_le_Pr_of_implies _ _ _ h_mem)
      apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
      exact h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ ϑ') Nat.one_le_two_pow V₀ V₁ h_line_prob
